title: Scan-to-Map Odometry Skeleton
hints: Constant velocity: the last relative motion is Δ = T₂⁻¹·T₁ (body frame), so the prediction is T₁·Δ.
VoxelHashMap: `std::unordered_map<Eigen::Vector3i, std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d>, Hash>` with a custom hash (XOR of coords × large primes) and key = floor(p / voxel_size).
removeFarFrom: iterate with `it = map.erase(it)` (erase returns the next iterator). Don't `++it` after erasing.

process(): first scan → identity pose, add to map, it's the first keyframe. Otherwise init = prediction from the last two poses (or the last pose if only one), T = register_(scan, map_, init), and update the map ONLY if isKeyframe(last_kf_, T).
